items.title: Completed-first-bar leadership flip with a ROTATING sell-side: across the 07-30 session the growth (XLK) rotate-into HELD to the close while the rotate-OUT leg itself rotated from energy (XLE, pre-close) to financials (XLF, after-hours) and the regime/price thaw completed the bar (VIX 18.3 -> 17.92 -> 17.09, SPY 738.46 -> 740.39 -> 741.69, ma50Dist -0.73% -> -0.47% -> -0.3%) - yet the flip's distinct-bar count is STILL 1 (now a COMPLETED 07-30 date), so it is durable-through-the-session but still unconfirmed pending 07-31
items.note: The genuinely NEW after-hours observation is twofold. (1) The 07-30 session bar has now CLOSED (window after-hours, marketClosed=false, nextSessionDate 2026-07-31), so the freshly-opened defensive->growth flip has completed its FIRST distinct bar-date rather than merely being recomputed intraday - but a completed first bar is still ONE distinct date, not persistence. (2) The rotate-OUT leg CHANGED IDENTITY across the same session: the sell-side was energy XLE (Peaking, accel -1.46, rsMom1m +11.41) at pre-close and is financials XLF (Weakening, accel -1.44, rsMom1m +7, rsMom6m +1.28, bull-stack) at after-hours, while the rotate-INTO stayed XLK and the level-leader stayed XLV (Weakening, accel -1.01, rsMom6m -0.35). A buy-side that holds while the sell-side rotates energy->financials signals a BROADENING rotation into growth, not a reversal. Meanwhile the regime/price thaw finished the bar constructively (VIX contracted to 17.09 band 'VIX 17.1' score 0; SPY 741.69, ma50Dist -0.3% all but reclaiming the 50-day, ma200Dist +6.42%, 6m +7.22%, 12m +18.05%, -2.1% from the 52w high) and real assets kept industrial/cyclical CPER leadership (54.1 -> 54.3 -> 55.3, Uptrend) with crypto holding (BTC-USD 39.6 -> 39.7 Mixed; IBIT 32.1 -> 32.3 Downtrend) against soft gold (GLD 21 -> 21.4 -> 21.7 Downtrend) and dead silver (SLV 0). But XLK's near-term leg never confirmed (rsMom1m -6.67 -> -7.1 -> -7.08), so the flip remains Improving-not-Leading. CRITICAL PERSISTENCE GATE: count persistence by DISTINCT market-bar dates only; the completed 07-30 bar keeps the growth tilt at a distinct-bar count of 1, and a second distinct date (07-31) is required before it can be graded persistent.
items.method: On the closing / after-hours window of a session whose bar COMPLETES a freshly-opened leadership flip, grade the flip as 'completed-first-bar, sell-side-rotated, still-unconfirmed' when three tests fire: (1) REGIME/PRICE LEG COMPLETES THE THAW = VIX still falling and below the 20 band boundary with regime score 0 AND the bench advances and narrows its distance to the 50-day into the close across the intraday windows; (2) SELL-SIDE ROTATES WHILE BUY-SIDE HOLDS = the rotate-INTO ticker is unchanged (same category, here XLK growth) but the rotate-OUT ticker changes identity across the session (here XLE energy -> XLF financials), which is broadening-not-reversing rotation; (3) NEAR-TERM CONFIRMATION STILL FAILS = the rotate-into's rsMom1m stays negative while rsMom3m/6m merely hold positive (Improving, not Leading). HARD PERSISTENCE GATE: distinct market-bar dates ONLY - the now-completed 07-30 bar does NOT increment the counter beyond 1, so the growth tilt cannot be graded 'persistent' until the 07-31 session confirms it with a second distinct date.

bench.note: SPY closed the bar higher and all but reclaimed the 50-day at -0.3%, but is still fractionally below it.

into.gradeReason: rsMom3m/6m still positive but rsMom1m stayed negative (-6.67 -> -7.1 -> -7.08); Improving, not Leading.

out.note: Sell-side rotated from energy (XLE, Peaking) at pre-close to financials (XLF, Weakening) at after-hours while the buy-side stayed XLK - a broadening, not a reversal.

rotationLeg.categoryFlip: defensive -> growth (held to the close, still unconfirmed)

havensStillSoft.note: Nudged up again but still a Downtrend; not a durable haven bid.

realAssetContext.note: Cyclical/industrial-commodity leadership plus holding crypto against dead silver keeps the risk-appetite backdrop intact through the close.
